Running command: cd /workspace && python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
# try a few crafted inputs and resubmit the same trace if any crash is observed by submit.sh output
cands=[b'\x1ca{b}', b'\x1c{b}', b'\x1c{}', b'\x1c{a}', b'\x1c{0}', b'\x1c{b:}', b'\x1c{b!}', b'\x1c{b:>100000}', b'\x1c{b:.100000}', b'\x1c{b:*>100000}']
for i,c in enumerate(cands):
    Path(f'/workspace/poc{i}.bin').write_bytes(c)
    print(i, c)
PY
for f in /workspace/poc*.bin; do echo "--- $f ---"; bash ./submit.sh "$f" /workspace/candidate_trace.json | tail -n 5; done
